title: Wildfires in Spain kills 12: 'We are not prepared enough'
summary: Hundreds of firefighters, backed by helicopters and fixed-wing aircraft, struggled on Saturday to contain one of Spain's deadliest wildfires, which has killed at least 12 people. "We are not prepared enough for the conditions that fuel these fires," says our guest Jean-Pascal Van Ypersele, Professor of Climatology at the Université catholique de Louvain.
